requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
This is a mid-level Subcontracts position supporting large EPC and industrial construction projects. The ideal candidate will bring prior experience supporting subcontract administration, purchase order management, subcontract compliance, vendor coordination, and project reporting within a fast-paced engineering or construction environment.
